yaml:
# HISS operator facility hiss.operator.stackgres: Setup prerequisites (PostgreSQL Provider design 2026-10-20 §9.1,
# P0 lab results §15-§16). Generated by tools/render-hiss-operator-stackgres.cjs; Setup pins these bytes by sha256 and
# applies them server-side (field manager opensphere-setup-hiss). Cluster Manager applies none of this.
# StackGres 1.19.3; operator ServiceAccount system:serviceaccount:opensphere-stackgres:stackgres-operator.
# S-1, S-2 Namespaces. PSA enforce=baseline is fixed (P0 §7.6: SGDbOps Jobs violate restricted); warn/audit restricted.
apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: opensphere-stackgres
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: opensphere-console
    opensphere.io/authority: hiss-operator-stackgres-v1
    stackgres.io/scope: opensphere-stackgres.stackgres-operator
    opensphere.io/managed-by: cluster-manager
    pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: baseline
    pod-security.kubernetes.io/warn: restricted
    pod-security.kubernetes.io/audit: restricted
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: opensphere-pfss-pg-shared
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: opensphere-console
    opensphere.io/authority: hiss-operator-stackgres-v1
    stackgres.io/scope: opensphere-stackgres.stackgres-operator
    opensphere.io/managed-by: foundation
    opensphere.io/operand-namespace: postgres
    pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: baseline
    pod-security.kubernetes.io/warn: restricted
    pod-security.kubernetes.io/audit: restricted
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: opensphere-pfss-pg-dedicated
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: opensphere-console
    opensphere.io/authority: hiss-operator-stackgres-v1
    stackgres.io/scope: opensphere-stackgres.stackgres-operator
    opensphere.io/managed-by: foundation
    opensphere.io/operand-namespace: postgres
    pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: baseline
    pod-security.kubernetes.io/warn: restricted
    pod-security.kubernetes.io/audit: restricted
---
# S-12 Write guard (design §5.2.2; closes the Console administrator impersonation path, P0 §5). The guards come right after the namespaces:
# Setup applies and type-checks them before any RBAC that they bound (review M5).
apiVersion: admissionregistration.k8s.io/v1
kind: ValidatingAdmissionPolicy
metadata:
  name: opensphere-pfss-pg-writers
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: opensphere-console
    opensphere.io/authority: hiss-operator-stackgres-v1
spec:
  failurePolicy: Fail
  matchConstraints:
    namespaceSelector:
      matchExpressions:
        - key: kubernetes.io/metadata.name
          operator: In
          values:
            - opensphere-pfss-pg-shared
            - opensphere-pfss-pg-dedicated
            - opensphere-stackgres
    resourceRules:
      - apiGroups:
          - stackgres.io
        apiVersions:
          - '*'
        operations:
          - CREATE
          - UPDATE
          - DELETE
        resources:
          - '*/*'
  variables:
    - name: user
      expression: request.userInfo.username
    - name: foundation
      expression: variables.user == 'system:serviceaccount:opensphere-foundation:foundation-control-plane'
    - name: operator
      expression: variables.user == 'system:serviceaccount:opensphere-stackgres:stackgres-operator'
    - name: clusterManager
      expression: variables.user == 'system:serviceaccount:opensphere-console:opensphere-cluster-manager-runtime'
    - name: kubeController
      expression: variables.user in ['system:serviceaccount:kube-system:generic-garbage-collector', 'system:serviceaccount:kube-system:namespace-controller']
    - name: operand
      expression: request.namespace in ['opensphere-pfss-pg-shared', 'opensphere-pfss-pg-dedicated']
    - name: localSa
      expression: 'variables.user.startsWith(''system:serviceaccount:'' + request.namespace + '':'') ? variables.user.substring(size(''system:serviceaccount:'' + request.namespace + '':'')) : '''''
    - name: clusterSa
      expression: variables.operand && (variables.localSa.endsWith('-patroni') || variables.localSa.endsWith('-backup'))
    - name: clusterName
      expression: 'variables.localSa.endsWith(''-patroni'') ? variables.localSa.substring(0, size(variables.localSa) - 8) : variables.localSa.endsWith(''-backup'') ? variables.localSa.substring(0, size(variables.localSa) - 7) : '''''
    - name: dbopsSa
      expression: variables.operand && variables.localSa.endsWith('-dbops')
    - name: subresource
      expression: 'has(request.subResource) ? request.subResource : '''''
    - name: sameSpec
      expression: request.operation == 'UPDATE' && has(object.spec) == has(oldObject.spec) && (!has(object.spec) || object.spec == oldObject.spec)
    - name: sameMetadata
      expression: |-
        request.operation == 'UPDATE'
        && (has(object.metadata.labels) ? object.metadata.labels : {}) == (has(oldObject.metadata.labels) ? oldObject.metadata.labels : {})
        && (has(object.metadata.annotations) ? object.metadata.annotations : {}) == (has(oldObject.metadata.annotations) ? oldObject.metadata.annotations : {})
        && (has(object.metadata.finalizers) ? object.metadata.finalizers : []) == (has(oldObject.metadata.finalizers) ? oldObject.metadata.finalizers : [])
        && (has(object.metadata.ownerReferences) ? object.metadata.ownerReferences : []) == (has(oldObject.metadata.ownerReferences) ? oldObject.metadata.ownerReferences : [])
  validations:
    - expression: |-
        variables.foundation && variables.operand || variables.operator || variables.kubeController
        || (variables.clusterSa && ((request.resource.resource == 'sgclusters' && variables.subresource == '' && request.name == variables.clusterName && variables.sameSpec)
        || (request.resource.resource == 'sgbackups' && variables.subresource == '')))
        || (variables.dbopsSa && request.operation == 'UPDATE' && variables.subresource == '' && (request.resource.resource == 'sgclusters' || (request.resource.resource == 'sgdbops' && variables.sameSpec)))
        || (variables.clusterManager && variables.operand && ((variables.subresource == '' && variables.sameSpec && variables.sameMetadata)
        || (request.operation == 'CREATE' && request.dryRun == true && request.resource.resource == 'sgpgconfigs' && request.name == 'osp-hiss-stackgres-verify')))
        || (variables.clusterManager && request.namespace == 'opensphere-stackgres' && request.operation == 'UPDATE' && request.resource.resource == 'sgconfigs' && variables.subresource == 'status' && request.name == 'stackgres-operator')
      messageExpression: '''opensphere-pfss-pg-writers: '' + variables.user + '' may not '' + request.operation + '' '' + request.resource.resource + (variables.subresource != '''' ? ''/'' + variables.subresource : '''') + '' in '' + request.namespace + '' (StackGres objects are written by Foundation and the StackGres operator only)'''
---
apiVersion: admissionregistration.k8s.io/v1
kind: ValidatingAdmissionPolicyBinding
metadata:
  name: opensphere-pfss-pg-writers
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: opensphere-console
    opensphere.io/authority: hiss-operator-stackgres-v1
spec:
  policyName: opensphere-pfss-pg-writers
  validationActions:
    - Deny
---
# S-12b Cluster account scope (P0 §16-3).
apiVersion: admissionregistration.k8s.io/v1
kind: ValidatingAdmissionPolicy
metadata:
  name: opensphere-pfss-pg-cluster-scope
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: opensphere-console
    opensphere.io/authority: hiss-operator-stackgres-v1
spec:
  failurePolicy: Fail
  matchConstraints:
    namespaceSelector:
      matchExpressions:
        - key: kubernetes.io/metadata.name
          operator: In
          values:
            - opensphere-pfss-pg-shared
            - opensphere-pfss-pg-dedicated
    resourceRules:
      - apiGroups:
          - ''
        apiVersions:
          - v1
        operations:
          - CREATE
          - UPDATE
          - DELETE
          - CONNECT
        resources:
          - pods
          - pods/exec
          - persistentvolumeclaims
          - endpoints
          - configmaps
          - services
  matchConditions:
    - name: cluster-account
      expression: |-
        request.userInfo.username.startsWith('system:serviceaccount:' + request.namespace + ':')
        && (request.userInfo.username.endsWith('-patroni') || request.userInfo.username.endsWith('-backup'))
  variables:
    - name: sa
      expression: request.userInfo.username.substring(size('system:serviceaccount:' + request.namespace + ':'))
    - name: cluster
      expression: 'variables.sa.endsWith(''-patroni'') ? variables.sa.substring(0, size(variables.sa) - 8) : variables.sa.substring(0, size(variables.sa) - 7)'
    - name: mutableLabels
      expression: '[''role'', ''nofailover'', ''noloadbalance'', ''stackgres.io/disruptible'']'
  validations:
    - expression: |-
        variables.cluster != '' && (request.resource.resource == 'pods' ? request.name.matches('^' + variables.cluster + '-[0-9]+$')
        : request.resource.resource == 'persistentvolumeclaims' ? request.name.matches('^' + variables.cluster + '-data-' + variables.cluster + '-[0-9]+$')
        : (request.name == variables.cluster || request.name in ['config', 'leader', 'failover', 'sync', 'primary', 'replicas', 'rest'].map(s, variables.cluster + '-' + s)))
      messageExpression: '''opensphere-pfss-pg-cluster-scope: '' + variables.sa + '' may act only on cluster '' + variables.cluster + '', not '' + request.resource.resource + '' '' + request.name'
    - expression: |-
        request.resource.resource != 'pods' || request.operation != 'UPDATE' || (has(request.subResource) && request.subResource != '')
        || ((has(object.metadata.labels) ? object.metadata.labels : {}).all(k, k in variables.mutableLabels || (has(oldObject.metadata.labels) && k in oldObject.metadata.labels && oldObject.metadata.labels[k] == object.metadata.labels[k]))
        && (has(oldObject.metadata.labels) ? oldObject.metadata.labels : {}).all(k, k in variables.mutableLabels || (has(object.metadata.labels) && k in object.metadata.labels)))
      messageExpression: '''opensphere-pfss-pg-cluster-scope: '' + variables.sa + '' may change only the Patroni role labels of a Pod'''
---
apiVersion: admissionregistration.k8s.io/v1
kind: ValidatingAdmissionPolicyBinding
metadata:
  name: opensphere-pfss-pg-cluster-scope
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: opensphere-console
    opensphere.io/authority: hiss-operator-stackgres-v1
spec:
  policyName: opensphere-pfss-pg-cluster-scope
  validationActions:
    - Deny
---
# S-12c Foundation names: Secrets and the Setup default-deny NetworkPolicy.
apiVersion: admissionregistration.k8s.io/v1
kind: ValidatingAdmissionPolicy
metadata:
  name: opensphere-pfss-pg-foundation-names
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: opensphere-console
    opensphere.io/authority: hiss-operator-stackgres-v1
spec:
  failurePolicy: Fail
  matchConstraints:
    namespaceSelector:
      matchExpressions:
        - key: kubernetes.io/metadata.name
          operator: In
          values:
            - opensphere-pfss-pg-shared
            - opensphere-pfss-pg-dedicated
    resourceRules:
      - apiGroups:
          - ''
        apiVersions:
          - v1
        operations:
          - CREATE
          - UPDATE
          - DELETE
        resources:
          - secrets
      - apiGroups:
          - networking.k8s.io
        apiVersions:
          - v1
        operations:
          - CREATE
          - UPDATE
          - DELETE
        resources:
          - networkpolicies
  matchConditions:
    - name: foundation-controller
      expression: request.userInfo.username == 'system:serviceaccount:opensphere-foundation:foundation-control-plane'
  validations:
    - expression: |-
        request.resource.resource != 'secrets'
        || request.name.matches('^[a-z0-9]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?-g[0-9]+-credentials$') || request.name.matches('^[a-z0-9]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?-tls$')
        || request.name.matches('^backup-[a-z0-9]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?$')
      messageExpression: '''opensphere-pfss-pg-foundation-names: Foundation may write only Secrets <instance>-g<n>-credentials, <instance>-tls or backup-<target>-*; got '' + request.name'
    - expression: request.resource.resource != 'networkpolicies' || request.name != 'default-deny'
      message: 'opensphere-pfss-pg-foundation-names: the default-deny NetworkPolicy belongs to Setup'
---
apiVersion: admissionregistration.k8s.io/v1
kind: ValidatingAdmissionPolicyBinding
metadata:
  name: opensphere-pfss-pg-foundation-names
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: opensphere-console
    opensphere.io/authority: hiss-operator-stackgres-v1
spec:
  policyName: opensphere-pfss-pg-foundation-names
  validationActions:
    - Deny
---
# S-12d SGClusters: resource split, names, dbops Jobs and the Cluster Manager touch.
apiVersion: admissionregistration.k8s.io/v1
kind: ValidatingAdmissionPolicy
metadata:
  name: opensphere-pfss-pg-sgclusters
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: opensphere-console
    opensphere.io/authority: hiss-operator-stackgres-v1
spec:
  failurePolicy: Fail
  matchConstraints:
    namespaceSelector:
      matchExpressions:
        - key: kubernetes.io/metadata.name
          operator: In
          values:
            - opensphere-pfss-pg-shared
            - opensphere-pfss-pg-dedicated
    resourceRules:
      - apiGroups:
          - stackgres.io
        apiVersions:
          - '*'
        operations:
          - CREATE
          - UPDATE
        resources:
          - sgclusters
  variables:
    - name: user
      expression: request.userInfo.username
    - name: localSa
      expression: 'variables.user.startsWith(''system:serviceaccount:'' + request.namespace + '':'') ? variables.user.substring(size(''system:serviceaccount:'' + request.namespace + '':'')) : '''''
    - name: clusterName
      expression: 'variables.localSa.endsWith(''-patroni'') ? variables.localSa.substring(0, size(variables.localSa) - 8) : variables.localSa.endsWith(''-backup'') ? variables.localSa.substring(0, size(variables.localSa) - 7) : '''''
    - name: dbopsSa
      expression: variables.localSa.endsWith('-dbops')
    - name: foundation
      expression: variables.user == 'system:serviceaccount:opensphere-foundation:foundation-control-plane'
  validations:
    - expression: |-
        !variables.foundation
        || (has(object.spec.pods) && has(object.spec.pods.resources) && has(object.spec.pods.resources.disableResourcesRequestsSplitFromTotal)
        && object.spec.pods.resources.disableResourcesRequestsSplitFromTotal == true)
      message: 'opensphere-pfss-pg-sgclusters: an SGCluster must set spec.pods.resources.disableResourcesRequestsSplitFromTotal: true'
    - expression: |-
        !variables.foundation || request.operation != 'CREATE'
        || (request.name.matches('^[a-z0-9]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?-g[0-9]+$') && !request.name.matches('-g[0-9]+-'))
      messageExpression: '''opensphere-pfss-pg-sgclusters: an SGCluster is named <instance>-g<n> with no other -g<n>- segment; got '' + request.name'
    - expression: '!variables.dbopsSa || variables.localSa.startsWith(request.name + ''-'')'
      messageExpression: '''opensphere-pfss-pg-sgclusters: '' + variables.localSa + '' may update only the SGCluster its SGDbOps is named after, not '' + request.name'
    - expression: |-
        variables.user != 'system:serviceaccount:opensphere-console:opensphere-cluster-manager-runtime' || request.operation != 'UPDATE'
        || (has(object.status) == has(oldObject.status) && (!has(object.status) || object.status == oldObject.status))
      message: 'opensphere-pfss-pg-sgclusters: Cluster Manager may only touch an SGCluster without changing it'
---
apiVersion: admissionregistration.k8s.io/v1
kind: ValidatingAdmissionPolicyBinding
metadata:
  name: opensphere-pfss-pg-sgclusters
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: opensphere-console
    opensphere.io/authority: hiss-operator-stackgres-v1
spec:
  policyName: opensphere-pfss-pg-sgclusters
  validationActions:
    - Deny
---
# S-12e SGBackups and SGDbOps stay with their own cluster.
apiVersion: admissionregistration.k8s.io/v1
kind: ValidatingAdmissionPolicy
metadata:
  name: opensphere-pfss-pg-cluster-objects
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: opensphere-console
    opensphere.io/authority: hiss-operator-stackgres-v1
spec:
  failurePolicy: Fail
  matchConstraints:
    namespaceSelector:
      matchExpressions:
        - key: kubernetes.io/metadata.name
          operator: In
          values:
            - opensphere-pfss-pg-shared
            - opensphere-pfss-pg-dedicated
    resourceRules:
      - apiGroups:
          - stackgres.io
        apiVersions:
          - '*'
        operations:
          - CREATE
          - UPDATE
          - DELETE
        resources:
          - sgbackups
          - sgdbops
  variables:
    - name: user
      expression: request.userInfo.username
    - name: localSa
      expression: 'variables.user.startsWith(''system:serviceaccount:'' + request.namespace + '':'') ? variables.user.substring(size(''system:serviceaccount:'' + request.namespace + '':'')) : '''''
    - name: clusterName
      expression: 'variables.localSa.endsWith(''-patroni'') ? variables.localSa.substring(0, size(variables.localSa) - 8) : variables.localSa.endsWith(''-backup'') ? variables.localSa.substring(0, size(variables.localSa) - 7) : '''''
    - name: dbopsSa
      expression: variables.localSa.endsWith('-dbops')
    - name: foundation
      expression: variables.user == 'system:serviceaccount:opensphere-foundation:foundation-control-plane'
    - name: target
      expression: 'request.operation == ''DELETE'' ? oldObject : object'
  validations:
    - expression: |-
        variables.clusterName == '' || request.resource.resource != 'sgbackups'
        || (has(variables.target.spec.sgCluster) && variables.target.spec.sgCluster == variables.clusterName)
      messageExpression: '''opensphere-pfss-pg-cluster-objects: '' + variables.localSa + '' may write only backups of cluster '' + variables.clusterName'
    - expression: '!variables.dbopsSa || request.resource.resource != ''sgdbops'' || variables.localSa == request.name + ''-dbops'''
      messageExpression: '''opensphere-pfss-pg-cluster-objects: '' + variables.localSa + '' may update only its own SGDbOps, not '' + request.name'
    - expression: |-
        !variables.foundation || request.resource.resource != 'sgdbops' || request.operation != 'CREATE'
        || (has(object.spec.sgCluster) && request.name.startsWith(object.spec.sgCluster + '-'))
      messageExpression: '''opensphere-pfss-pg-cluster-objects: an SGDbOps is named <cluster>-<operation>; got '' + request.name'
---
apiVersion: admissionregistration.k8s.io/v1
kind: ValidatingAdmissionPolicyBinding
metadata:
  name: opensphere-pfss-pg-cluster-objects
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: opensphere-console
    opensphere.io/authority: hiss-operator-stackgres-v1
spec:
  policyName: opensphere-pfss-pg-cluster-objects
  validationActions:
    - Deny
---
# S-12f Services written by cluster accounts stay ClusterIP.
apiVersion: admissionregistration.k8s.io/v1
kind: ValidatingAdmissionPolicy
metadata:
  name: opensphere-pfss-pg-cluster-services
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: opensphere-console
    opensphere.io/authority: hiss-operator-stackgres-v1
spec:
  failurePolicy: Fail
  matchConstraints:
    namespaceSelector:
      matchExpressions:
        - key: kubernetes.io/metadata.name
          operator: In
          values:
            - opensphere-pfss-pg-shared
            - opensphere-pfss-pg-dedicated
    resourceRules:
      - apiGroups:
          - ''
        apiVersions:
          - v1
        operations:
          - CREATE
          - UPDATE
        resources:
          - services
  matchConditions:
    - name: cluster-account
      expression: |-
        request.userInfo.username.startsWith('system:serviceaccount:' + request.namespace + ':')
        && (request.userInfo.username.endsWith('-patroni') || request.userInfo.username.endsWith('-backup'))
  validations:
    - expression: (!has(object.spec.type) || object.spec.type == 'ClusterIP') && !has(object.spec.externalIPs)
      message: 'opensphere-pfss-pg-cluster-services: a cluster account may only write ClusterIP Services without external IPs'
---
apiVersion: admissionregistration.k8s.io/v1
kind: ValidatingAdmissionPolicyBinding
metadata:
  name: opensphere-pfss-pg-cluster-services
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: opensphere-console
    opensphere.io/authority: hiss-operator-stackgres-v1
spec:
  policyName: opensphere-pfss-pg-cluster-services
  validationActions:
    - Deny
---
# S-3 Default deny in each PostgreSQL namespace. Foundation renders the allowances per instance (design §5.2.1).
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: default-deny
  namespace: opensphere-pfss-pg-shared
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: opensphere-console
    opensphere.io/authority: hiss-operator-stackgres-v1
spec:
  podSelector: {}
  policyTypes:
    - Ingress
    - Egress
---
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: default-deny
  namespace: opensphere-pfss-pg-dedicated
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: opensphere-console
    opensphere.io/authority: hiss-operator-stackgres-v1
spec:
  podSelector: {}
  policyTypes:
    - Ingress
    - Egress
---
# S-4 Operator ClusterRole: reads only (P0 §15).
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: ClusterRole
metadata:
  name: opensphere-stackgres-operator
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: opensphere-console
    opensphere.io/authority: hiss-operator-stackgres-v1
rules:
  - apiGroups: ['']
    resources: [namespaces]
    verbs: [get, list]
  - apiGroups: [storage.k8s.io]
    resources: [storageclasses]
    verbs: [get, list]
  - apiGroups: [apiextensions.k8s.io]
    resources: [customresourcedefinitions]
    resourceNames: [sgbackups.stackgres.io, sgclusters.stackgres.io, sgconfigs.stackgres.io, sgdbops.stackgres.io, sgdistributedlogs.stackgres.io, sginstanceprofiles.stackgres.io, sgobjectstorages.stackgres.io, sgpoolconfigs.stackgres.io, sgpgconfigs.stackgres.io, sgscripts.stackgres.io, sgshardedbackups.stackgres.io, sgshardedclusters.stackgres.io, sgshardeddbops.stackgres.io, sgstreams.stackgres.io]
    verbs: [get]
  - apiGroups: [apiextensions.k8s.io]
    resources: [customresourcedefinitions]
    verbs: [list]
---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: ClusterRoleBinding
metadata:
  name: opensphere-stackgres-operator
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: opensphere-console
    opensphere.io/authority: hiss-operator-stackgres-v1
roleRef:
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
  kind: ClusterRole
  name: opensphere-stackgres-operator
subjects:
  - kind: ServiceAccount
    name: stackgres-operator
    namespace: opensphere-stackgres
---
# S-6 Operator Role in its own namespace (SGConfig, leader lease; P0 §15).
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: stackgres-operator
  namespace: opensphere-stackgres
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: opensphere-console
    opensphere.io/authority: hiss-operator-stackgres-v1
rules:
  - apiGroups: [apps]
    resources: [deployments]
    verbs: [list]
  - apiGroups: [batch]
    resources: [jobs]
    verbs: [get, list]
  - apiGroups: [coordination.k8s.io]
    resources: [leases]
    verbs: [get, create, update]
  - apiGroups: ['']
    resources: [configmaps, endpoints, persistentvolumeclaims, services]
    verbs: [list, watch]
  - apiGroups: ['']
    resources: [pods]
    verbs: [get, list, watch]
  - apiGroups: ['']
    resources: [secrets]
    verbs: [get, list, watch]
  - apiGroups: ['']
    resources: [serviceaccounts]
    verbs: [get, list]
  - apiGroups: ['']
    resources: [events]
    verbs: [create, patch]
  - apiGroups: [rbac.authorization.k8s.io]
    resources: [roles, rolebindings]
    verbs: [list]
  - apiGroups: [stackgres.io]
    resources: [sgconfigs]
    verbs: [create, get, list, watch]
  - apiGroups: [stackgres.io]
    resources: [sgconfigs/status]
    verbs: [update]
  - apiGroups: [stackgres.io]
    resources: [sgbackups, sgclusters, sgdbops, sgdistributedlogs, sginstanceprofiles, sgobjectstorages, sgpgconfigs, sgpoolconfigs, sgscripts, sgshardedbackups, sgshardedclusters, sgshardeddbops, sgstreams]
    verbs: [list, watch]
---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
